facebookAccount.notes: Cookies come from account.txt (read-only for the bot). userAgent: leave empty to use the FCA's own Chrome fingerprint, or paste the exact User-Agent of the browser your cookies were exported from. allowPasswordLogin stays false: a password login creates a second session.

e2ee.notes: Off by default: the FCA's E2EE engine needs optional packages (fca-unofficial from GitHub, @noble/curves, @noble/hashes ...) that are not installed on most hosts, and it registers an extra device on your account. Set enable=true only after installing them.

maintenanceMode.message: 🛠️ বট বর্তমানে মেইনটেন্যান্সে আছে, একটু পরে চেষ্টা করো।

antiSpam.notes: timeFrameSeconds সময়ের মধ্যে maxMessages এর বেশি মেসেজ পাঠালে muteSeconds সময়ের জন্য ইউজারের মেসেজ প্রসেস করা বন্ধ থাকবে (flood protection).

commandPerformance.notes: কোনো command চালাতে এর বেশি সময় লাগলে logs/performance.log এ লেখা হবে।

noPrefix.notes: mode: off=prefix required for all | admin=only bot admins skip prefix | all=everyone skips prefix

reactUnsend.notes: If enable = true, bot will unsend any message reacted with these emojis. If onlyAdmin = true, only adminBot IDs can trigger it.

whiteListMode.notes: If enabled, only IDs in whiteListIds can use the bot.

whiteListModeThread.notes: If enabled, only threads in whiteListThreadIds can use the bot.

security._notes: If true, command error stack traces are sent into the chat/group where the error happened (useful for a private dev bot). Keep false for any bot used by others - full details are always still written to logs/error.log regardless of this setting.

autoRestart.notes: null = no scheduled restart. Example: 3600000 (1hr) or 0 4 * * * (daily 4 AM).

twoIdMode.notes: Set enable to true and paste a second Facebook account's cookies into account2.txt to turn this on. If the primary account (account.txt) fails to log in / gets logged out this many times in a row, the bot automatically swaps in the account2.txt cookies and keeps running instead of staying offline.

autoUptime.notes: Time in seconds. Recommended for uptime monitors.

restartListenMqtt.notes: Listener refresh every ~15 min (+-15% jitter). Facebook reaction deltas were observed to go silent after ~20-25 min on one MQTT session with the previous FCA. If reactions stay reliable for days with @eryxenx/fca you can raise timeRestart (e.g. 3600000) or set enable=false to reduce reconnects.

notiWhenListenMqttError.notes: Notification settings when MQTT stops listening.

optionsFca.notes: Docs: https://github.com/ntkhang03/fb-chat-api/blob/master/DOCS.md#apisetoptionsoptions | Set reactionDebug to true temporarily to log the full message_reaction pipeline (raw event, dispatch, Map lookup, handler result) if reactions ever stop firing again.
optionsFca._fixNote: Only keys @eryxenx/fca knows are forwarded (see bot/login/fcaOptions.js). logLevel / enableE2EE / reactionDebug / autoMarkDelivery stay here for other bot code but are not sent to the FCA.

fca._note: @eryxenx/fca 1.1.7 (from npm). sessionGuard saves a copy of the live cookie jar to data/session/appstate.live.json (account.txt is never overwritten). allowFacebookLogout=false turns api.logout() into a local stop so the bot cannot end your browser session.

nsfw.notes: mode: off = nobody | admin = only adminBot IDs (default) | all = everyone. A command is NSFW when its category is 'nsfw' or its name is in extraCommands.

http.notes: timeoutMs = default axios timeout. retries = automatic retries for GET on network/5xx errors. apiBaseUrl: if set, every request to rewriteFrom is sent to this base instead (e.g. your own gateway).

notesTypingIndicator: true = show 'is typing...' before every reply (more human-like, adds visible delay) | false = reply instantly, no typing shown

humanBehavior.notes: Real Messenger clients always send read/delivered receipts. markAsRead respects the old autoseen on/off command. Set both to false for a fully passive bot.

autoBackup.notes: Zip of database (+sqlite file / mongo export), config.json and cmd data. redactSecrets=true blanks passwords/tokens/URIs inside the config copy so remote backups never carry them; restore keeps your local secrets. account*.txt cookies are NEVER backed up. Drive needs a refresh token created with the drive.file scope (the Gmail one will not work).

groupSettings.notes: Per-group prefix / language / command on-off through the `gset` command. Group admins can change their own group when allowGroupAdmins=true.

rateLimit.notes: Sliding-window limit per user per command, on top of each command's own countDown cooldown. Edit live with the `ratelimit` command.

reminders.notes: `remind kal 9tay assignment dite hobe`, `remind 10 minute pore chai khabo`, `remind 25/12 8:30pm birthday`. Stored in data/reminders.json and survive restarts.

hotReload.notes: Watches scripts/cmds and scripts/events. Add, edit or delete a file and the command is loaded/reloaded/unloaded with no restart. A file with a syntax error is skipped and the old version keeps running.

bridge.notes: Control the bot from Telegram/Discord: /status /threads /say /maintenance /reload /backup /restart /ratelimit. Only adminChatIds / adminUserIds can use it; everyone else is ignored silently.
